metadata.description: Plugins from gonsoomoon-ml/claude-extensions: deck-design (slide deck design and build), concise-response (summary-first responses) and infographic-design (one feed-post infographic that survives blurring and reposting: design schemes, tokens, templates, render and lint).

plugins.name: deck-design
plugins.description: Build slide decks that survive critic review: deck-mindset (design rules and template profiles), deck-build (tokens, build patterns, validate → render → inspect QA loop) and deck-agent-team (Phase-2 review via parallel critic agents with a PASS/FAIL gate).

plugins.name: concise-response
plugins.description: Summary-first responses in Korean, injected by a SessionStart hook: short summary first, only the details needed, full detail on request; Korean replies to English or Korean prompts (English on request).

plugins.name: infographic-design
plugins.description: Make one infographic image for a LinkedIn or feed post: infographic-mindset (three tests, canvas and type fixed by the feed, one accent, three design schemes taken from shipped images) and infographic-build (tokens.css + base.css, three HTML/SVG templates, render.py for Chromium PNG + text/layout report, lint.py for overflow, text budget, 16px floor, light small text, one accent, no literal hex, and a defects table).
